plans.name: Classic 60
plans.notes: Fact sheet re-read 26 Oct (same version as last week); price unchanged. Terms: the fact sheet waives the early termination charge on account closure (no outstanding bills); our ETF wording lists only the amounts.
plans.evidence: Discount off SP Regulated Tariff plan: Up to 8% off ( 3% off SP Regulated Tariff + 5% Prompt Payment Discount*)

terms.deposit_source: Security Deposit | (see footnote 7): | HDB 1 and 2 Room - $80 | HDB 3 Room - $110 | HDB 4 Room - $160 | HDB 5 Room - $190 | HDB Executive, Jumbo or Multi-Gen - $230 | Condominium, Apartment or Shophouse - $240 | Terrace - $360 | Semi-Detached - $500 | Bungalow or Penthouse - $1,000
terms.etf_source: Early Termination Charge (ETC) | (see footnote 6): | The ETC for the Classic 60 Plan will be waived upon account closure, provided there are no outstanding bills. Otherwise, the following charges shall apply: | HDB 1 and 2 Room - $160 | HDB 3 Room - $220 | HDB 4 Room - $320 | HDB 5 Room - $380 | HDB Executive, Jumbo or Multi-Gen - $460 | Condominium, Apartment or Shophouse - $480 | Terrace - $720 | Semi-Detached - $1,000 | Bungalow or Penthouse - $2,000
terms.etf: Waived when you close your account, as long as no bills are outstanding. Otherwise: HDB 1 and 2 room S$160; HDB 3 room S$220; HDB 4 room S$320; HDB 5 room S$380; HDB Executive, Jumbo or Multi-Gen S$460; condo, apartment or shophouse S$480; terrace S$720; semi-detached S$1,000; bungalow or penthouse S$2,000.

issues: Prices unchanged (all 10 fact sheets same versions as last week). YUU12 promo (Savvy Saver 12, Sunny Side-Up 12) ends today, 26 Oct. Terms: Classic 60's ETF is waived on account closure (missing from our wording). Our deposit wording for all plans ('Varies by residential dwelling type') is vague: the fact sheets list S$80-S$1,000 by home type, waived for recurring credit card payments.
